analysis.one_line_summary: Black Friday static receipt graphic offering the WavyTalk Volume & Wave Duo (Power Wave + Blowout Boost) for $125 (36% off).
analysis.full_description: A square graphic promotional post styled as a crumpled white receipt against a dark textured burgundy background. At the top of the receipt, the WavyTalk logo appears above 'Black Friday', followed by '$125.00 | 36% OFF' and a banner stating 'You save: $69.00'. An itemized line specifies 'VOLUME & WAVE DUO: Power Wave + Blowout Boost', showing the two pink styling tools side by side at the bottom. A circular sticker on the right reads 'TODAY ONLY', with barcode accents on the edges.
